description: Simulates a sequential data processing pipeline where tool outputs feed into subsequent analysis steps. Tests the model's ability to maintain state and produce correct aggregations.

input.scenario: Analyze monthly sales data, generate insights, and produce a board-ready report

stages.name: data_ingestion
stages.prompt: Load the sales data from the database and validate the schema. Confirm row count and column types.
stages.output: Schema validation report with row count

stages.name: data_cleaning
stages.prompt: Remove duplicates, handle null values in the revenue column (fill with median), and flag outliers (>3 std dev).

stages.name: statistical_analysis
stages.prompt: Compute descriptive statistics, trend analysis, and seasonality decomposition for the cleaned data.
stages.output: Statistics summary with trend and seasonality components

stages.name: segmentation
stages.prompt: Segment customers into high-value, medium-value, and low-value tiers based on revenue contribution. Apply Pareto analysis.

stages.name: visualization
stages.prompt: Create visualizations: (1) revenue trend line chart, (2) segment pie chart, (3) regional heatmap. Save all as files.

stages.name: report_generation
stages.prompt: Compile all findings into a structured board report with executive summary, key metrics, segment analysis, and recommendations.
